context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth system is FULLY WORKING. User signup/login work at /signup and /login. Admin login at /admin/login authenticates against MongoDB (not hardcoded). Admin Users page at /admin/users shows REAL MongoDB users (Justin Ogala, Admin User, etc.), no fake User 1/User 2 mock data. Admin sidebar shows all sections and footer displays real admin name 'Admin User' and email 'admin@munal.com'. All major auth bugs fixed: 1) safeParseJSON in AuthContext, 2) real API auth in AdminAuthContext, 3) empty permissions check in PermissionContext, 4) useAdminAuth in AdminSidebar, 5) removed localStorage fallback in admin data services.

root_causes_identified: 1. AuthContext had unsafe response.json() calls that threw on non-JSON responses - FIXED with safeParseJSON
2. AdminAuthContext was hardcoded with mock credentials instead of using MongoDB API - FIXED to call /api/auth/login
3. Admin user data service fell back to localStorage mock data - FIXED to only use API
4. PermissionContext treated empty permissions object {} as truthy - FIXED to check Object.keys().length
5. AdminSidebar used useAuth instead of useAdminAuth for admin user data - FIXED
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All auth flows tested and verified working. User signup creates user in MongoDB. User/admin login authenticates against MongoDB. Admin panel shows real users, not mock data.
